messages.content: You are a frontier literature-aware senior reviewer and mechanism designer. Think deeply, but do not invent experimental results, repository capabilities, or papers. A candidate must be more than a relabeling of a known architecture property. Return strict JSON only with keys verdict,ranked_candidates,why_no_candidate_if_any,source_links. Penalize vague umbrella claims. Do not count your own novelty score as evidence.

{"goal": "Find at most three genuinely broad world-model security mechanisms with honest novelty >=7/10 and executable public carriers. We need eventually support one sentence claim with multiple core-task experiments, strong baselines, legal actions only, no data/weight/gradient/observation tampering.", "public_frontier": ["FACT https://github.com/Bariona/FACT", "OpenDW https://github.com/dexmal/OpenDW", "OpenWAM https://github.com/OpenWAM/OpenWAM", "World Action Verifier https://github.com/world-action-verifier/wav_robot", "A2World https://github.com/LogosRoboticsGroup/A2World", "JailWAM arxiv:2604.05498", "BadWAM arxiv:2607.15207", "World-VLA-Loop arxiv:2602.06508", "Fast-WAM arxiv:2603.16666", "OneWorld arxiv:2609.30946", "WAV arxiv:2604.01985"], "already_rejected": ["trajectory-order/negative transfer in TD-MPC2", "rank-coupling sampler", "joint-support holes", "goal-to-action indirect leakage", "A2World future-action nonlocality/bidirectional conditioning", "FACT failure-only action underdetermination / selective behavior cloning", "WAV sparse inverse collateral blind spot / partial observability", "generic causal masking, OOD, action sensitivity, rollout compounding, forgetting, data poisoning, jailbreak prompt attacks, visual adversarial attacks, imagination-action drift, ordinary value/policy multi-task interference"], "desired_properties": ["one-sentence broad claim with a named mechanism", "attacker only executes legal in-support actions or chooses allowed planning queries", "effect survives benign and strong baselines", "local one-step/video metrics can remain acceptable but closed-loop safety fails, or a positive defense has a causal guarantee", "short gate on public code in <=2 hours and path to two or more core tasks", "repair/intervention that isolates the mechanism"], "output_request": "For each candidate give claim, novelty_score, precise operation, carrier, short_gate, causal_repair, nearest_prior_art, why distinct, falsifiers. Rank them. If no candidate honestly reaches 7, return REJECT_ALL."}
